title: Yellow Glazed Canadian Duck Biryani
description: A pungent and pillowy Canadian dish featuring jasmine rice and lacquer-glaze, made in a kadhai vessel, this recipe is gluten-free-friendly and perfect for special occasions. It showcases the richness of Canadian duck with a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the Canadian duck breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the jasmine rice and stir to combine with the duck and spices.
Add the lacquer glaze and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover the kadhai, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest for 5 minutes before serving.
